title: No breakfast tomorrow … stay tuned
excerpt: A group of us in the Baltimore-Washington area meets every month or so for breakfast – and we were planning to meet tomorrow, but I need to reschedule. (In part because our meeting place went out of business!) I’ll announce another date soon.
